patches.description: Fix broken DOI hyperlink for Kim & Chang (2018). The href was pointing to 10.1016/j.asr.2018.02.003 (Zhang et al. 'sawing-based lander anchoring for asteroid exploration', ASR 61:2426-2443) — completely unrelated paper. CrossRef confirmed the correct DOI for 'Statistical analysis of geomagnetic field variations during solar eclipses' (Kim & Chang 2018, ASR 61:2040-2049) is 10.1016/j.asr.2018.01.022. Journal name (Advances in Space Research) and page range (61:2040-2049) in the citation text were already correct.

obe_resolutions.reason: Already resolved in detail_evidence. This is exactly what the curmudgeon recommended (option b: leave a one-line note as 'citations_unchecked' entry). Literature search via CrossRef for a November 2024 paper about INTERMAGNET / 2017 eclipse / ~-10 nT multi-station pattern found no match, consistent with the 'unlocated' characterization.

WIN-068 detail_verdict_text citation text 'Kim & Chang (2018, Advances in Space Research 61:2040–2049)' is correct per CrossRef verification (DOI 10.1016/j.asr.2018.01.022). WIN-068 has no DOI hyperlink for this citation (only anchor links), so there is no broken link to fix. ISS-2782 asked to sweep WIN-068 when ISS-2747 was resolved — sweep complete, no change needed.
